map.checker-manager：在线输入参数即可即时得到结果，无需安装与注册。: checker-manager: enter parameters online and get the result instantly, with no installation or registration required.
map.仓储与生产环境对温湿度有明确要求，属于现场检查的固定项；把它与条款分并列，可提醒: Warehouses and production environments have explicit temperature and humidity requirements and are fixed items in on-site inspection; listing this alongside clauses reminds you that exceeding environmental limits also constitutes a nonconformity.
map.内审准备：按八项条款逐条打分，先自行定位薄弱环节: Internal audit preparation: score the eight clauses one by one and locate your weak points first
map.医疗健康类结果为按公式得到的估算值，不能替代医生诊断与处方。给药剂量、补液速度、: Health results are formula-derived estimates and cannot replace a doctor's diagnosis or prescription. Dosing, fluid rate, anticoagulation and thrombolysis decisions must follow the drug label, clinical guidelines and the attending physician; for chest pain, breathing difficulty or altered consciousness seek care immediately.
map.建议按证据充分性给分：有制度且有执行记录给 8–10 分，仅有制度给 4–7 分: Score by strength of evidence: 8-10 points with both a policy and execution records, 4-7 with only a policy, 0-3 with neither; avoid giving everything the same score, which would leave the result with no discrimination.
map.总分 = 八项检查得分之和（每项 0–10，满分 80）: Total = sum of the eight check scores (0-10 each, 80 total)
map.打分标准怎么定？: How do you set the scoring standard?
map.月度复核：固定口径重复评分，观察达标率趋势: Monthly review: repeat the scoring with a fixed definition and watch the pass rate trend
map.温湿度为什么也计入？: Why are temperature and humidity counted too?
map.迎检自查：把现场温湿度记录一并录入，输出整改优先级: Inspection self-check: enter on-site temperature and humidity records as well to output a rectification priority order
map.：例1（八项均 10 分）：总分 80，达标率 100.0%，说明各条款均已落实: : example 1 (all eight items at 10): total 80, achievement rate 100.0%, so every clause is implemented. Example 2 (all eight at 5): total 40, achievement rate 50.0%, needing rectification of the lowest scoring clauses first.
map.：算法：八项检查各按 0–10 分录入，满分 80；达标率 = 总分 ÷ 80: : algorithm: enter each of the eight checks as 0-10, full marks 80; achievement rate = total ÷ 80 × 100; then combine the recorded temperature and humidity for an overall grade. Each item must be a value between 0 and 10.
